```{r}
con <- dbConnect(MySQL(),
                 user="root",
                 host="localhost",
                 db = "baseball-research")

training_sql <- "SELECT * FROM statcast_pitching WHERE game_year >= 2021 AND game_year < 2025 AND game_type = 'R'"

testing_sql <- "SELECT * FROM statcast_pitching WHERE game_year >= 2025 AND game_type = 'R'"

data_train <- dbGetQuery(con, training_sql)
data_test <- dbGetQuery(con, testing_sql) |> filter(game_year > 2024)

```

```{r}

pitching_pbp <- data_train |>
  select(player_name, pitcher, pitch_name, at_bat_number,
         pitch_number, description, launch_speed_angle, plate_x, plate_z,
         release_speed, release_spin_rate, release_extension, spin_axis, release_pos_x, release_pos_z, pfx_x, pfx_z,
         p_throws, stand, game_year, game_date, vx0,
         vy0, vz0, ax, ay, az, arm_angle) |>
  drop_na(!launch_speed_angle)

pitching_processed <- pitching_pbp |>
  mutate(vy_f = -sqrt((vy0^2 - (2 * ay * (50 - (17/12))))),
         t = (vy_f - vy0) / ay,
         vz_f = vz0 + (az * t),
         vx_f = vx0 + (ax * t),
         VAA = -atan((vz_f / vy_f)) * (180 / pi),
         HAA = -atan((vx_f / vy_f)) * (180 / pi),
         v_mag = sqrt(vx0^2 + vy0^2 + vz0^2),
         tang_x = vx0 / v_mag,
         tang_y = vy0 / v_mag,
         tang_z = vz0 / v_mag,
         handedness_factor = if_else(p_throws == "R", 1, -1),
         temp_x = 0,
         temp_y = 0,
         temp_z = 1,
         horz_x_raw = temp_y * tang_z - temp_z * tang_y,
         horz_y_raw = temp_z * tang_x - temp_x * tang_z,
         horz_z_raw = temp_x * tang_y - temp_y * tang_x,
         horz_mag = sqrt(horz_x_raw^2 + horz_y_raw^2 + horz_z_raw^2),
         horz_x = horz_x_raw / horz_mag,
         horz_y = horz_y_raw / horz_mag,
         horz_z = horz_z_raw / horz_mag,
         vert_x = tang_y * horz_z - tang_z * horz_y,
         vert_y = tang_z * horz_x - tang_x * horz_z,
         vert_z = tang_x * horz_y - tang_y * horz_x,
         a_tang = ax * tang_x + ay * tang_y + az * tang_z,
         a_horz = ax * horz_x + ay * horz_y + az * horz_z,
         a_vert = ax * vert_x + ay * vert_y + az * vert_z) |>
  select(-c(vx0:az, vy_f:vx_f, v_mag:a_tang))

pitching_processed <- pitching_processed |>
  mutate(pfx_x = pfx_x * 12,
         pfx_z = pfx_z * 12,
         stand = as.numeric(factor(stand)) - 1,
         plate_x_og = plate_x,
         plate_z_og = plate_z,
         plate_x = 0,
         plate_z = 2.5)

pitching_processed <- pitching_processed |>
  mutate(PitchGroup = case_when(pitch_name %in% c("4-Seam Fastball", "Sinker", "Cutter") ~ "Fastball",
                                pitch_name %in% c("Slider", "Sweeper", "Curveball", "Slurve",
                                                  "Knuckle Curve", "Slow Curve", "Screwball") ~ "BreakingBall",
                                pitch_name %in% c("Changeup", "Split-Finger", "Forkball") ~ "Offspeed",
                                pitch_name %in% c("Eephus", "Knuckleball", "Other") ~ "Other",
                                TRUE ~ NA))

VAA_preds = predict(.VAA_Model, pitching_processed) |> rename(xVAA = .pred)

HAA_preds = predict(.HAA_Model, pitching_processed) |> rename(xHAA = .pred)

pitching_processed = bind_cols(pitching_processed, VAA_preds, HAA_preds) |>
  select(player_name:pitch_name, PitchGroup, at_bat_number:stand, arm_angle:VAA, xVAA, HAA, xHAA, a_horz:plate_z_og, game_date, game_year)
```

```{r}

FB_avg <- pitching_processed |>
  filter(pitch_name %in% c("4-Seam Fastball", "Sinker")) |>
  group_by(player_name, pitcher) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    FBvelo = mean(release_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    FBvbreak = mean(pfx_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    FBhbreak = mean(pfx_x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: Cutter data
Cutter_data <- pitching_processed |>
  filter(pitch_name == "Cutter") |>
  group_by(player_name, pitcher) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    CTvelo = mean(release_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    CTvert = mean(pfx_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Join and Compare
Cutter_labeled <- Cutter_data |>
  left_join(FB_avg, by = c("player_name", "pitcher")) |>
  mutate(
    VeloRatio = CTvelo / FBvelo,
    pitch_name = "Cutter",
    new_group = case_when(
      is.na(FBvelo) & CTvert > 5 ~ "Fastball",
      is.na(FBvelo) ~ "BreakingBall",
      VeloRatio >= 0.95 ~ "Fastball",
      CTvert <= 5 ~ "BreakingBall",
      VeloRatio <= 0.935 ~ "BreakingBall",
      TRUE ~ "Fastball"
    )
  ) |> select(player_name, pitcher, pitch_name, new_group)

# Step 4: Combine with rest of data
pitching_processed <- pitching_processed |>
  left_join(Cutter_labeled, by = c("player_name", "pitcher", "pitch_name")) |>
  mutate(PitchGroup = if_else(pitch_name == "Cutter", new_group, PitchGroup)) |>
  select(-new_group)

pitching_processed <- pitching_processed |>
  left_join(FB_avg |> select(-c(n)), by = c('player_name', 'pitcher')) |>
  mutate(RelSpeedDiff = release_speed - FBvelo,
         Horz_Accel_Diff = a_horz - FBhbreak,
         Vert_Accel_Diff = a_vert - FBvbreak,
         launch_speed_angle = ifelse(is.na(launch_speed_angle), 0, launch_speed_angle)) |>
  na.omit()

```

```{r}

Swing = c('hit_into_play', 'foul','foul_tip', 'swinging_strike', 'swinging_strike_blocked',
          'foul_bunt', 'missed_bunt', 'bunt_foul_tip')
Whiff = c('swinging_strike', 'swinging_strike_blocked', 'foul_tip', 'bunt_foul_tip')
Foul = c('foul', 'foul_bunt')

pitching_processed = pitching_processed |>
  mutate(Swing = case_when(description %in% Swing ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0),
         Whiff = case_when(description %in% Whiff ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0),
         Foul = case_when(description %in% Foul ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0),
         BIP = launch_speed_angle,
         CalledStrike = case_when(description == 'called_strike' ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0),
         HBP = case_when(description == 'hit_by_pitch' ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0))

```

modelData = vprocessedData |>

```{r}

modelPrep = function(dataFrame, pitchType, outcomeType){
  if (outcomeType == "Whiff"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      mutate(Label = as.factor(Whiff)) |>
      select(-c(ID, Swing, Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP, player_name))

  } else if (outcomeType == "Foul"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      mutate(Label = as.factor(Foul)) |>
      select(-c(ID, Swing, Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP, player_name))

  } else if (outcomeType == "BIP"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      filter(BIP != 0) |>
      mutate(Label = as.factor(BIP - 1)) |>
      select(-c(ID, Swing, Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP, player_name))

  } else if (outcomeType == "CalledStrike"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      mutate(Label = as.factor(CalledStrike)) |>
      select(-c(ID, Swing, Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP, player_name))

  } else if (outcomeType == "HBP"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      mutate(Label = as.factor(HBP)) |>
      select(-c(ID, Swing, Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP, player_name))

  } else {
    print("Invalid Outcome Type: (Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP)")
    stop()
  }
}

log_message <- function(msg, pitchType, outcomeType, pHand) {
  log_path <- paste0(
    "C:/Users/Mason/Desktop/Code/Baseball-Research/Stuff-Plus/2.0/models/", pHand, "/", outcomeType, "/", pitchType, "_", outcomeType,"_","log.txt"
    )
  con <- file(log_path, open = "a")  # 'a' means append mode
  writeLines(paste0(Sys.time(), " - ", msg), con)
  close(con)
}

trainStuffModels <- function(dataFrame, pitchType, outcomeType, pHand){

  if (outcomeType %in% c('Whiff', 'Foul', 'BIP', 'CalledStrike', 'HBP')){
    set.seed(1015)

    data_split = initial_validation_split(dataFrame, prop = c(0.8, 0.1), strata = Label)
    train = training(data_split)
    test = testing(data_split)
    val_set = validation_set(data_split)
    val = validation(data_split)

    spec = boost_tree(trees = tune(), min_n = tune(), tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = tune(), sample_size = tune()) %>%
      set_mode("classification") %>%
      set_engine("xgboost", nthread = 16)

    rec = recipe(Label ~ ., data = train)

    wf = workflow() %>%
      add_model(spec) %>%
      add_recipe(rec)

    registerDoParallel(makeCluster(8))

    log_message(paste0("Starting Tuning"), pitchType, outcomeType, pHand)
    print(paste0("Starting Tuning: ", Sys.time()))

    tune_res = wf %>%
      tune_bayes(resamples = val_set,
                 initial = 20,
                 iter = 100,
                 control = control_bayes(verbose = TRUE, no_improve = 5, seed = 1015),
                 metrics = metric_set(roc_auc))

    best_params = select_best(tune_res, metric = "roc_auc")

    log_message(paste0("Starting Fitting"), pitchType, outcomeType, pHand)
    print(paste0("Starting Fitting: ", Sys.time()))

    final_model = wf %>%
      finalize_workflow(best_params) %>%
      fit(data = train)

    log_message(paste0("Ended Fitting"), pitchType, outcomeType, pHand)
    print(paste0("Ended Fitting: ", Sys.time()))

    saveRDS(final_model, paste0(wd, "/models/", pHand, "/", outcomeType, "/", pitchType, "_", outcomeType, "_", Sys.Date(), "_", format(Sys.time(), "%H-%M"), ".rds"))

    preds = predict(final_model, test, type = "prob") %>%
      bind_cols(test)

    if (outcomeType == "BIP") {
      # Calculate Multiclass AUC
      auc_res = roc_auc(data = preds, truth = Label,
                        .pred_0, .pred_1, .pred_2, .pred_3, .pred_4, .pred_5,
                        estimator = "hand_till")
    } else {
      # Calculate Binary AUC
      auc_res = roc_auc(preds, Label, .pred_0)
    }

    write.csv(auc_res,
              paste0(wd, "/models/", pHand, "/", outcomeType, "/", pitchType, "_", outcomeType, "_", Sys.Date(), "_", format(Sys.time(), "%H-%M"), "_Error.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)

    vip_plot = final_model %>%
      extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
      vip(num_features = 40) +
      ggtitle(paste0(pitchType, " - ", outcomeType, ":  Feature Importance"))

    ggsave(filename = paste0(wd, "/models/", pHand, "/", outcomeType, "/", pitchType, "_", outcomeType, "_", Sys.Date(), "_", format(Sys.time(), "%H-%M"), "_VIP.png"),
           plot = vip_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

    return(final_model)

  } else {
    log_message(paste0("Invalid Outcome Type: (Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP)"), pitchType, outcomeType, pHand)
    print("Invalid Outcome Type: (Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP)")
    stop()
  }

}

```
